MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The outdoor fastening tape fits my recent interest in attaching and mounting things, so I could see choosing it for a light mounting task.",
    "Its weather resistance connects with my recent outdoor deck screws, although I would still check whether it suits the surface and load."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Locking nuts, metal-cutting wheels, calipers and electrical test leads serve different tasks from the nails, wood screws and wall anchors I have recently needed.",
    "Glue could be useful for repairs, but ten tubes exceed my current needs; the large packs of gloves, wipes and wastebaskets also lack a clear purpose for me.",
    "The medicine cups do not establish a current need for home tests or exam gloves, and replacement vacuum bags do not imply that I need wastebaskets."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The suggestions seem to treat tools and hardware as interchangeable, when the specific fastening or repair task determines what I would choose.",
    "My purchases of large packs of nails and screws seem to have been taken as a broader preference for bulk supplies, but those quantities were tied to particular needs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of nails, wood screws and anchors point most clearly toward construction fastening and mounting needs.",
    "Compatibility matters: nail angle and dimensions, screw size, mounting surface and tool requirements can determine whether an otherwise related item is useful.",
    "An occasional purchase of medicine cups or vacuum bags should carry less weight than my repeated fastening purchases when anticipating my next project supply."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions partly recognized my mounting needs but stretched them into unrelated tools, household supplies and bulk purchases."
}
